name: AVIC Research Institute for Special Structures of Aeronautical Composites

evidence.summary: The US Entity List names it as an AVIC research institute (also listed as AVIC’s 637th Research Institute). AVIC is one of the state-owned defence-industry groups that SASTIND lists, and says its businesses include aviation weapons and equipment and military transport aircraft. The US Commerce Department listed it in December 2022 for acquiring and attempting to acquire US-origin items in support of China’s military modernization, citing ties to activities including hypersonic weapons development.
It belongs to AVIC, which describes itself as a very large state-owned enterprise managed by the central government.
